title: Odile and the Compass
author: Emrys Marchetti
blurb: Petra Galloway, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
